en: Udāna 6.3 Paccavekkhaṇasutta Thus have I heard:
On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now on that occasion the Blessed One was sitting reflecting on how he had abandoned many evil, unwholesome states and had brought many wholesome states to fulfillment through development.

Then, having understood that he had abandoned many evil, unwholesome states and had brought many wholesome states to fulfillment through development, on that occasion the Blessed One uttered this inspired exclamation:
“It was not so before, then it was not so;
it was not so before, then it was so. It has not been so, nor will it ever be.”
